real_defects.issue: money() took its sign from the rounded cents but printed the unrounded magnitude, and Math.round rounds -0.5 toward zero, so money(-0.005) printed '0.01' (a half-cent loss shown as a gain in the per-order net and per-platform tables). Fixed: cents() rounds halves away from zero for both signs and money() prints abs(cents(n)); test 'money signs follow the rounded cents'.

The formatter `${x < 0 ? "-" : ""}$${Math.abs(x).toFixed(2)}` takes the sign from the raw value and the digits from the rounded one, so float noise (0.3-0.1-0.2 = -2.8e-17) or any loss under half a cent printed -$0.00. Fixed by platform/ci/money_sign.py --fix (minus kept only when the printed digits are not 0.00); guarded by platform/ci/test_money_sign.py over every tracked venture file.
